description: Claiborne Linvill, candidate for SC House District 3, was an invited speaker at a large gathering hosted by Oconee Women for Progress, the Oconee County Democratic Party, and Indivisible Oconee. Claiborne was one of several invited speakers, including statewide candidates for governor and treasurer, who addressed a large crowd at Biggerstaff Christian Retreat and Conference Center in Seneca, SC.
